params.body:
The trend page put a two-line explainer under the headline, which took a lot of room and said nothing a reader needs. The evidence line on cards and pages read, for example, "A lead: borne out by 1 signal from 17 sources, 21 more in part". That line mixed two counts: the signals a model judged to bear the trend out, and every source of the trend. The verdict itself is a model's judgement that nobody reads before the trend goes up.

## What changes

- **`TrendCard::evidenceLine`** counts only, for example "31 signals from 12 sources", or platforms when there are no sources. No Holds, no A lead, no "not yet checked". The kinds line under it stays ("23 observed on platforms, 8 from press").
- **Trend page:** under the headline only the seen line remains ("Seen 23 times on platforms, last on 3 November 2026."). The explainer is gone.
- **Trends list:** the note at the foot no longer explains when a trend holds; evidence is how many signals a trend rests on, and from how many sources.

## Tests

- `php artisan test`: 595 of 597. One of the failures is `BuildStampTest`, which only fails in a git worktree. The other was `EvidenceKindsTest` asserting the old line, now updated. Pint passes.
- `MomentumInWordsTest`:
  - the line is the count;
  - a judged trend shows no verdict on the list or its page.
params.title: Trend pages: plain counts, no verdict, no explainer
